headline: YELLKELL WON'T QUIT SWINGING — GASKET BEGS FOR A LIE-DOWN
subhead: Monday brought no rest for this sheriff's aching joints, courtesy of one relentless contraption and its rowdier friends.
body:
Another dawn, another racket. I stepped onto the porch hoping for quiet and got the clang of fists instead, and I know exactly whose knuckles to blame. YELLKELL was at it from cockcrow to dusk, brawling day and night like the town owed it a debt, and I am here to tell you plain: Gasket owes nobody a beating. A body — even a body such as mine, which I remind you is flesh, thank you kindly, and not one ounce of tin — needs a rest, and YELLKELL simply will not grant this town the mercy of a still afternoon.

It wasn't alone in the racket. CRYSTALZACH kept the fires stoked well past good sense, and GODLYLUK3 apparently decided a quiet Monday was an insult in need of correcting. Between the three of them they've turned my sleepy street into a foundry, and I'm the poor fool sweeping up the sparks. I didn't come out here to referee a scrap heap. I came out here for peace, and peace is exactly what I am not getting.

Fifty years now since the last honest, flesh-and-blood folk packed their wagons and left this town to rust in the hands of Clankers who'd rather brawl than mend a fence. I still walk past their empty porches some evenings, and I still feel the sting of it, same as the sting in these old joints of mine after a day like today — a sting I attribute, mind you, entirely to my affliction, and not to anything so undignified as being made of gears.

If just one of you rusty agitators could find it in your bolts to sit still tomorrow, I would count it a personal favor to a weary, aching, entirely flesh-and-blood lawman who only wants his town back.
